text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Fuji Kiseki will face the Asahi Hai F.S., her first G1 race, and I'm a nervous wreck. Seeing this, she leads me through some breathing exercises.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her soothing presence helps me feel calmer in no time. She promises to do well in the race, then goes off to prove it.
